title: Exploration of Modeling and Optimization Methods of Single Photon Avalanche Diode
content: Single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) have great potential in astronomy, fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy (FLIM), quantum communication, and other high-precision sensing and imaging applications. However, further optimization of SPAD performance is often constrained by fabrication time and cost. In this work, we develop a technology computer-aided design (TCAD) simulation flow for a custom SPAD. We propose models for the I-V characteristics, breakdown voltage, dark count rate (DCR), and photon detection probability (PDP). These models are calibrated against measurements across a wide range of bias voltages and temperatures. We also investigated the effects of specific process parameters on device performance. This work provides a method for accurate SPAD design and optimization.
